name: artifact-customs
description: Clear, adopt, maintain, replace, and retire exact third-party software components under explicit policy.

interface.shortDescription: Clear and maintain third-party software components.
interface.longDescription: Artifact Customs separates read-only component clearance, explicit trust-boundary adoption, and policy-bound maintenance while composing existing review, Git, and pull-request owners.
defaultPrompt: Use $artifact-customs:assessing-third-party-components to assess this exact third-party software component without mutation.
Use $artifact-customs:adopting-third-party-components to establish or revise the explicit policy for this new trust boundary.
Use $artifact-customs:maintaining-third-party-components to update, investigate, replace, seal, or retire this component under its existing policy.
